marketing_description: The Leviton R12-AGTR1-0KW GFCI outlet features a voltage rating of 125 V, an amperage rating of 15 A, and a frequency rating of 60 Hz, making it suitable for various applications. This 2-pole, 3-wire outlet has a NEMA 5-15R rating and is self-grounding for added convenience. The outlet also includes tamper-resistant shutters, auto-monitoring/self-test functionality, and an audible trip alarm indicator for enhanced safety.
